verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows users operating BILL Spend & Expense through natural-language commands. The MCP server only lets AI tools query the API documentation, not act on the product. The 'AI-powered spend management' and Invoice Coding Agent claims describe automatic categorization and coding, not conversational command interfaces, so they are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
